Revenue.description: Monetary value of sales or revenue generated by transactions before or after tax depending on the source context; use context to distinguish it from tax, discounts, or refunds.

COGS.description: Direct cost attributable to products or services sold, including cost of goods sold, product cost, or direct cost of sales.

Operating Expense.description: Indirect operating expenses such as rent, salaries, marketing, utilities, administration, and similar costs not directly attributable to the product sold.

Tax.description: Tax amount associated with a transaction, including VAT or sales tax where applicable.

Customer.description: Customer, client, buyer, account, or party receiving the sale.

Product.description: Product, SKU, item, service, or item description associated with a transaction.

Transaction Date.description: Date when the sale, invoice, or transaction occurred.

Quantity.description: Units, quantity, or number of items sold in a transaction.

Payment Status.description: Whether an invoice or transaction is paid, unpaid, partially paid, overdue, pending, or similar.

Transaction Type.description: Classification of the transaction such as revenue, expense, purchase, refund, sale, or other financial transaction type. Use this field when another column determines the financial meaning of a shared monetary amount.

Invoice Number.description: Unique invoice, bill, or transaction identifier.

Net Profit.description: Net or final profit amount associated with the transaction or accounting record.

Profit Margin.description: Profit margin expressed as a percentage or decimal ratio.
